title: Customer Support Analyst II
description:

title: Associate Director Precision Medicine - Clinical Diagnostics
description:
Build our future together:

We're seeking an Associate Director to lead companion diagnostic (CDx) strategy and development, bridging translational science with diagnostic execution. This role owns companion diagnostic programs from early biomarker feasibility through clinical validation, regulatory submission, and launch - translating biological insights and clinical hypotheses into validated, fit-for-purpose assays that support drug development decisions. You'll work at the interface of biomarker science, clinical development, regulatory, and external IVD partners to ensure diagnostics keep pace with therapeutic milestones.

When & where:

• Location: Remote, USA

Discover your role:

• Translate emerging biomarker and mechanism-of-action data into diagnostic target product profiles, defining assay intent across platforms (Next Generation Sequencing, polymerase chain reaction, immunohistochemistry, immunoassays).

• Partner with translational and clinical teams to design biomarker strategies for patient selection, stratification, and enrichment, including sample strategy and specimen logistics.

• Lead analytical and clinical validation planning (accuracy, precision, sensitivity/specificity, limit of detection, reproducibility), linking assay performance to clinical safety and efficacy endpoints.

• Set global CDx strategy for assigned programs, aligning diagnostic milestones with clinical and regulatory timelines.

• Select and oversee In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) development partners; manage co-development scope, timelines, and quality expectations.

• Support global regulatory strategy and submissions (Food and Drug Administration PMA/supplement, EU IVDR, PMDA) in collaboration with IVD Regulatory, including labeling alignment.

• Ensure compliance with relevant standards (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CLSI, IVDR, GCP alignment).

• Lead cross-functional working groups, translating scientific rationale into program plans and clear governance reporting.

• Support design transfer, manufacturing readiness, and launch preparation with commercial and medical affairs.

This role requires:

• PhD or advanced degree in molecular biology, pathology, biomedical engineering, or related translational/biomedical science field.

• 8+ years in diagnostics or translational research, with 4+ years leading biomarker-driven CDx or IVD programs bridging bench discovery and clinical application.

• Track record translating biomarker science into validated assays supporting drug approvals.

• Working knowledge of global CDx regulatory pathways (FDA CDRH, EU IVDR, PMDA).

• Ability to translate complex scientific and clinical data for cross-functional and executive audiences.

• Experience managing external partners and multi-workstream programs under QMS/GxP-adjacent conditions.

title: Infrastructure Architect
description:
Our Infrastructure Architectserves as the critical technical expert responsible for all post-sales deployment and integration of the Epistemix platform into client infrastructure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role.
You will be the vital link between our product's architecture and our clients' varied technical landscapes. This role requires the ability to be both a hands-on architect and navigating complex client IT, security, and application environments (AWS, GCP, private cloud, or on-prem) to successfully deploy our product and ensure immediate value realization.
About Epistemix
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.
Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.
Responsibilities

• Design and execute the technical strategy for integrating the Epistemix platform into client environments.

• Leverage Terraform, Kubernetes and Docker across client environments, ensuring security and repeatability with a primary focus on AWS and data connections like Snowflake and Databricks.

• Interface with client IT organization to understand infrastructure environment and provide architectural guidance during implementation.

• Ensure all client-side integration and deployment methods are designed to meet rigorous standards, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001, HIPAA.

• Work with client IT organizations to set deployments in complex settings, including public cloud (AWS/GCP), private cloud, and traditional on-premises/dedicated application environments.

• Develop and use custom automation tooling (Python is a must) to streamline deployment processes, integrating with client-side identity and access management (e.g., OAuth2/OIDC).

Qualifications

• 8+ years of industry experience, 3+ years of architectural implementation experience

•
Hands on and expert level experience in:

• Python, Fast API and/or Django

• Terraform. Additional knowledge of Kubernetes, and Docker highly preferred.

• AWS infrastructure. General architectural mastery of another major cloud provider (GCP) is highly valued.

• Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or a relevant technical discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Epidemiology, or Public Health

• Demonstrated experience managing or contributing to organizational compliance programs, specifically the development and implementation of policies and procedures related to HIPAA (HITECH Act) privacy/security rules and achieving SOC 2 attestation

• Experience with data warehouse integrations with Snowflake, Databricks or other data warehouse platforms.

• Experience managing and supporting deployments in environments beyond public cloud (e.g., on-premise, private cloud, or dedicated client application environments).

Nice to Have Experience

• Familiarity with the architectural demands of distributed computing librari

title: Amazon Image Brief & Conversion Associate
description:
Amazon images are where most listings win or lose. The main image decides whether anyone clicks. The six behind it decide whether they buy - and whether the parcel comes back.
We are hiring one person to own that. Take a live listing, work out from its reviews and returns why it is not converting, and write the image brief that fixes it - a brief a remote designer can execute without a single follow-up question.
This is an operational and analytical role, not a design role. You will not be making the artwork. You decide what it has to say, in what order, and you hold the returned files to that standard.
The split is 75 / 25.

•
75% - the briefs. The conversion thinking, the ranked USPs, the seven slots, the QA of what comes back.

•
25% - analysis and reporting. Part of it is the work that feeds the brief: pulling the reviews, reading them properly, turning them into a persona and a pain-point list. The rest is the follow-up reporting we owe clients - sales and traffic, return reasons, and what actually moved once new images went live.

You will work across markets. Mostly European and US listings, across many markets and languages, in categories you have never shopped in yourself.
What you will do
Image briefs and conversion thinking - 75% of the role

• Diagnose why a listing is not converting: what the gallery fails to answer, which objection nobody addressed, where the buyer loses confidence and leaves.

• Know what each slot is for. The main image earns the click. Images two to seven answer objections in the order a buyer actually raises them. The size and fit slots decide whether the sale stays sold.

• Rank seven USPs by what wins the click and what prevents a return. They are not the same list, and the order is the decision.

• Write the brief for each slot in our template: one message per slot, one headline, an optional subline, a maximum of three to four callouts, every line adding something new.

• Apply the two-second rule. One idea per image, legible at thumbnail size on a phone. If a slot needs a paragraph to work, it is not a slot.

• Work inside the client’s brand book - colours, fonts, existing assets - naming exactly which asset to reuse and where the file lives.

• Keep sizing accurate and internally consistent: backend size chart against image size chart, US against EU conventions.

• Know Amazon image policy cold: main-image rules, no price, ratings, review counts or badges, and how the gallery renders on a phone.

• QA the returned files against the brief and say precisely why something is not working - hierarchy, contrast, whitespace, text density, whether a close-up box earns its place.

The analysis behind the briefs - part of the 25%

• Download the reviews yourself and read them properly: themes, frequency, and the exact words customers use.

• Pull Voice of the Customer and the return report, and weight return reasons against units actually sold.

• Turn that into a buyer persona and a ranked pain-point list - for categories you did not grow up in.

• Separate “we can fix this on the listing” from “the product is the problem”.

• Evidence only. Never invent a return reason, a measurement or a number, and ask when something is missing.

Reporting that follows up sales - the rest of the 25%

• Find and download the right reports without being walked through it: Sales & Traffic, Search Query Performance, Returns, Voice of the Customer.

• Build the recurring follow-ups: sales and traffic trend, return rate by size, conversion before and after an image update.

• Merge two exports on ASIN or SKU and produce a clean pivot, without hand-counting rows.

• Deliver a one-page summary that says what matters, why it matters and what to do about it. Not a data dump.

Making the workflow better with AI - across all of the above

• Use Claude and ChatGPT as part of the work, not as a novelty: review analysis, first-draft copy, translation, summarising exports.

• Work inside our Claude projects, with the context

title: Lead Product Manager, Growth
description:
📍London/Hybrid | 💰 Salary range £120,000 - £140,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits ✨

 

 

What you’ll be working on ⭐

As a Lead Product Manager for Growth, you will define and deliver the future of how people first experience Monzo. This is a rare opportunity to lead one of Monzo’s most strategically critical product domains, owning high-complexity bets that shape how millions of people discover, join and trust our bank.

You will own the strategic direction across our core growth engines: how we attract, onboard and activate people from their very first interaction. For our team, this means optimising the entire sign-up experience, removing activation friction, designing seamless new user journeys, and building powerful referral loops that turn everyday banking utility into organic network effects.

You’ll set a compelling multi-cycle vision, craft multiple high-signal strategies, and create the experimentation engine that turns ambition into reality. We’re looking for someone who pairs an analyst's data rigour with world-class product craft, and possesses the conviction to make non-obvious bets without precedent.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

• Leading the charge: set a durable product vision and strategy that spans multiple cycles, ensuring alignment with Monzo’s goals and an exceptional customer experience.

• Communicating effectively: you get people inspired by the product vision and you share the right context with the right people at the right time.

• Collaborating seamlessly: lead through influence across collectives, building deep partnerships with engineering, design, data, fincrime, legal and marketing to resolve complex organisational trade-offs.

• Delivering impact: define, deliver and measure the impact of the customer-focused experiences you create.

• Establishing high-velocity operating rhythms that empower squads to switch seamlessly between rapid experimentation, deep iteration and bold 0-1 builds.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You are a seasoned growth product manager, and have led multiple high-performing teams to ship world-class products at a fast growing company.

• You have a track record of leading high-scale consumer growth efforts that drive significant top of funnel value for customers and scaling for the business. 

• You're exceptionally data-driven and commercial, and you know when to lean on rapid experimentation and when to move quicker with high conviction from first principles.

• You can systematically break down high-ambiguity product spaces that lack precedent, structuring clear narratives that cut through noise and align teams.

• You have excellent judgement, and have a track record of making good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”. 

• You hold an uncompromising standard for product craft, moving effortlessly between high level company strategy and deep execution.

• You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.

• You’re a great storyteller, who is able to motivate, energise and inspire people towards a common goal.

• You have experience mentoring, coaching or managing other product managers, setting a high performance bar and multiplying your impact through the people around you.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £120,000 - £140,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

title: NCDR TVT Registry Abstractor
description:
Why ADN? Join the American Data Network family and become part of an established, purpose-driven healthcare quality organization with more than 30 years of experience. At ADN, our work supports hospitals and healthcare clients in improving quality, patient safety, and clinical outcomes. We value integrity, accuracy, collaboration, and professionalism, and we are looking for experienced abstractors who take pride in producing high-quality work.
Position Summary: American Data Network is seeking experienced NCDR TVT Registry Abstractors to support accurate and timely cardiovascular registry abstraction for assigned healthcare clients. This role is ideal for candidates with recent, hands-on TVT abstraction experience who can independently review clinical documentation, apply registry specifications, and meet assigned deadlines with a high level of accuracy.
This is not a general data entry position. Candidates must have direct healthcare registry, clinical chart review, quality reporting, or data abstraction experience specific to NCDR TVT.
Position Details: ADN hires both contractors and full-time employees for Data Abstraction roles. Contractors must be available for a minimum of 15 hours per week.
Key Responsibilities:

• Reviews patient medical records and abstracts data for the NCDR TVT Registry.

• Applies registry specifications, definitions, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and abstraction guidelines accurately and consistently.

• Interprets clinical documentation related to cardiology procedures, diagnoses, treatments, outcomes, complications, and related quality measures.

• Enters accurate and complete data into assigned registry platforms, EHRs, vendor tools, or other data collection systems.

• Maintains a high level of abstraction accuracy, completeness, and attention to detail.

• Meets assigned productivity expectations, weekly progress goals, and internal and client deadlines.

• Participates in quality assurance activities, including feedback, correction, validation, and IRR reviews.

• Communicates professionally with account leads, team members, and client contacts when clarification is needed.

• Maintains strict confidentiality and complies with ADN, client, HIPAA, and data security requirements.

Qualifications:
Required:

• At least 2 years of recent NCDR TVT Registry abstraction experience.

• Ability to independently abstract TVT cases using registry specifications and clinical documentation.

• Strong understanding of healthcare quality reporting, registry abstraction, clinical documentation review, and medical record interpretation.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.

• Comfort working in multiple EHRs, registry platforms, vendor tools, and data collection systems as assigned.

• Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

• Contractors must have high-speed secure internet, a PC or laptop, and at least two monitors.

Preferred:

• Experience using the NCDR application, NCDR reports, and/or other related data collection tools.

• Experience with IRR, QA review, audit validation, and/or abstraction accuracy review.

Screening & Onboarding: Qualified candidates will complete an initial phone screen and a TVT-specific abstraction assessment. The assessment is designed to evaluate understanding of registry specifications, abstraction judgment, accuracy, and completion speed.
ADN does not provide basic TVT abstraction training, so candidates should already have the registry experience needed for the role. After hire, ADN provides onboarding to ADN processes, client systems, EHR access, documentation tendencies, and other client-specific workflows.

title: REMOTE (INDIA): AI Engineer- SaaS Platform
description:
Role Overview
We are looking for an AI Engineer to maintain and enhance the AI-driven backbone of the Sootra platform. This role involves ensuring production stability of LLM/VLM pipelines, optimizing model interactions, maintaining APIs and queues, and building feedback loops that continuously improve AI outputs.
Responsibilities

• Maintain and optimize LLM- and VLM-powered services for content generation, compliance scoring, and campaign testing.

• Manage and scale Flask/FastAPI microservices, ensuring high uptime and low latency.

• Maintain Dramatiq queues for async AI workflows, campaign generation, and pipeline orchestration.

• Deploy, monitor, and debug Uvicorn/Gunicorn-based hosting in production environments.

• Integrate with OpenRouter and equivalent LLM routing tools to balance cost, latency, and quality.

• Design and refine prompt engineering strategies for reliability, context-awareness, and compliance.

• Build and maintain feedback pipelines for AI model evaluation (human-in-the-loop scoring, automated quality checks, reinforcement).

• Expose and maintain REST APIs for AI services, ensuring secure, versioned endpoints.

• Collaborate with backend/frontend teams to keep microservice architecture aligned and maintainable.

• Track token consumption, latency, and error rates to ensure production-grade performance.

Required Skills

• Programming: Strong in Python, with experience in production-grade codebases.

• Frameworks: Flask (for APIs), FastAPI (optional), Uvicorn/Gunicorn for async hosting.

• Queues/Workers: Dramatiq (or Celery/RQ equivalent) for background jobs.

• AI/ML: Hands-on with LLMs and VLMs, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

• AI Infrastructure: Familiar with OpenRouter or equivalent LLM/VLM routing & fallback tools.

• Architecture: Experience designing and maintaining microservice architectures.

• APIs: Strong experience with REST API design (auth, rate limiting, documentation).

• Production: Dockerized deployments, CI/CD pipelines, logging/monitoring, error handling.

• Feedback Loops: Building structured evaluation/feedback systems for AI model performance.

• Cloud: AWS/GCP experience preferred (deployment, monitoring, scaling).

Experience

• 3-5 years as an AI Engineer or Python Backend Engineer working with production systems.

• Prior work with SaaS platforms, LLM/VLM integrations, or AI-first products is highly valued.

Demonstrated ability to maintain AI pipelines in production, not just prototypes.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Grafana Search & Storage | US | Remote

About the Role: We are seeking an experienced Senior Factoring Underwriter & Credit Specialist with direct, hands-on expertise in accounts receivable (A/R) factoring. In this role, you will lead the credit evaluation, risk structuring, and day-to-day portfolio oversight of invoice factoring facilities for high-growth e-commerce, CPG, and B2B wholesale businesses.

This role is specifically tailored for an expert who understands the operational, legal, and credit nuances of invoice factoring. What You’ll Need:

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

ElevenLabs runs a deliberately lean finance team across 10+ legal entities and 40+ countries. REQUIREMENTS

- You've administered a multi-entity NetSuite OneWorld instance yourself, including SuiteScript

The role

As Head of Video, Berlin, you will shape how HelloFresh makes video for our international markets: the paid social engine, organic social, and our long-form YouTube content. Building and managing the team and systems behind all of it. You will lead the Berlin video team, including our international XPod, our fast and experimental content engine. Paid social is our biggest growth lever and the largest part of this role, but we do not want to lose the rest. Organic, long-form and brand storytelling all matter, and a strong Head of Video makes them work together. Whilst the scope is on our International market, we actively seek greater global collaboration. 

HelloFresh is at a pivotal moment of transformation. We are moving towards a modular, global content system, bringing AI-assisted workflows into how we plan, shoot and edit, and balancing centralised brand standards with local market needs. Berlin makes content for up to 14 markets that each need localisation, translation and cultural care, with local market teams who have a say on what ships. Our international XPod is a younger team than its New York counterpart, and part of your job is to bring it to the same standard, cadence and strategy.

You will need to be as comfortable discussing channel metrics, spend and creative testing as you are discussing a script or a shot. You will partner closely with the Growth, Creative Strategy and Brand teams, with the XPod Director in North America, and with our Photo, AI, Culinary and Studio Operations teams, and you will have a real voice in how video works across the whole group.

What you’ll do

Studio Leadership & People

A strong video team is how we keep creative capability and institutional knowledge through a period of rapid change. You will lead, develop and inspire the Berlin video team, across XPod, organic social and long-form.

• Set clear performance expectations, agree individual growth plans, and keep a healthy performance culture through regular 1:1s and honest, timely feedback.

• Build and develop a team that spans producers, editors, creative strategists and post-production, and create career paths that keep talent with us.

• Hire well, onboard well and keep the standard high as the team grows, including moving roles from freelance to full-time where it makes sense.

• Create an open, supportive team culture where concerns are raised early and good ideas can come from anyone.

Paid Social & Performance

Paid social is where we see the strongest return for the business. You will make international XPod a fast, reactive and experimental performance engine.

• Deliver paid social content that performs, to brief, prioritised with the Growth and channel teams.

• Run a clear test-and-learn rhythm across hooks, formats, creators and channels, and use performance data, including spend and cost per result, to decide what to make next.

• Attend regular Growth meetings to align on performance, localisation, trends and channel spend, and turn what you learn into briefs and shoot plans quickly.

• Build a lean creative strategy function inside the team that works hand in hand with Growth and Brand.

• Bring Berlin XPod up to the cadence, tooling and strategy of our most mature XPod team, and share one way of working.

Organic & Long-Form YouTube

We want to keep investing in organic and long-form content alongside paid. Both build the brand and feed the paid engine.

• Own the organic social video plan and grow it with the right talent, cadence and measures.

• Lead our long-form YouTube content, currently focused on the UK, and develop it into a global proposition where the audience and the budget support it.

• Make sure every long-form and organic shoot creates cut-downs, hooks and pickup shots that can serve paid, search and YouTube campaigns.

• Keep the quality and storytelling of our brand video high, from short-form to long-form.

Localisation & Modular Content

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

YOUR ROLE

Pricing is one of the biggest levers Zip has to capture the value we create for customers, and today it is shared across Product, Deal Strategy/Ops, and Product Marketing. As Zip's first Head of Pricing & Packaging, you will own pricing and packaging as one function, with a single strategy, a single set of rules, and a single process for getting new products to the field.

- You own the whole function: strategy, packaging, governance, and the operating rhythm. There is no existing team, playbook, or system to inherit.

- You are both the strategist and the doer. You will build the models, run the research, write the policies, and make the call, then defend it in front of founders and the executive team.

- You will work through Product, Product Marketing, Deal Strategy/Ops, Sales, Finance, and Legal without formal authority over any of them.

- Headcount will be earned. You will decide what the function needs, size it, and make the business case for it. Expect to start as a team of one.

- Own pricing strategy across Zip's portfolio, including new product and module pricing, packaging tiers, and bundling.

- Run willingness-to-pay and competitive research (conjoint, Van Westendorp, benchmarking) and turn it into clear recommendations grounded in customer value.

- Design packaging that is simple for buyers to understand and leaves room for expansion.

- Chair a cross-functional pricing council that aligns Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing and drives decisions to resolution.

- Build and own a new product introduction (NPI) process that carries the product roadmap through to field readiness.

PRICING OPERATIONS AND GOVERNANCE

- Stand up what doesn't exist today: discounting policy, approval workflows, exception governance, and deal desk guardrails, in partnership with the existing Deal Desk team.

- Define and report on pricing KPIs, including win rate by price point, discount leakage, price realization, and expansion ARR from packaging changes.

- Evaluate pricing and CPQ tooling with Deal Desk as Zip's needs mature.

LEADERSHIP

- Be the company's authority on monetization, bringing market and competitive pricing intelligence into executive and product planning.

- Present pricing recommendations and business cases to the founders and executive team.

- Build the case, roadmap, and hiring plan for a pricing team as the function matures.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years in pricing strategy, monetization, or revenue strategy, including 5+ years owning pricing and packaging at a B2B SaaS or technology company.

- Ownership of pricing and packaging for a multi-product or platform business: you made and defended the decisions, not only the analysis behind them.

- A track record of building or substantially standing up a pricing or commercial strategy function, with measurable results such as NRR improvement, ARR acceleration, or competitive win-rate gains.

- Experience influencing founders, C-suite, or board-level audiences, and aligning Product, Sales, Fina

If you thrive in a fast-paced, AI-driven environment and want to move revenue rather than chase activity metrics, this is your seat.

More than 100 customers run VIDIZMO in production across public safety and justice, government, healthcare, financial services, education, legal, manufacturing, and energy, much of it on premises, air-gapped, or in FedRAMP High environments on a CJIS Security Policy-aligned architecture.

VIDIZMO is an NVIDIA Inception partner and a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Data & AI, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, and buyable through GSA, Carahsoft, and state/cooperative contract vehicles.

• Own new business in your territory, from first conversation to signed contract.

• Run discovery and demos for our products: AI Intelligence Hub, Digital Evidence Management, Redactor, AI Live Insight and EnterpriseTube.

• Work with SDRs, partners and pre-sales engineers on deals with several decision-makers.

• Build relationships with IT, security, legal, operations and executive leaders.

• Keep pipeline and forecasts accurate in HubSpot.

What you bring

• 2+ years in a quota-carrying SaaS role: AE, account manager, or a senior SDR/BDR ready to close.

• Experience selling to enterprise, government, public safety, healthcare, legal or education organizations.

• Strong written and spoken English, and comfort presenting to senior buyers.

• A self-starter mindset in a remote, fast-moving team.

• A bachelor’s degree.

• Willingness to travel for meetings, demos, conferences, and partner activities.

• U.S. market experience.

• Authorization to work in the United States.

Why VIDIZMO

• Sell AI that solves real problems for agencies and enterprises.

• Remote, with travel for key meetings and events, and a team that backs you with pre-sales, partners and marketing.

• Room to grow as we expand our US sales team.

You're expected to use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to strengthen your outputs - but AI-generated work is never final without your review. You own accuracy, completeness, logic, compliance, and business alignment on every deliverable, regardless of the tools used to produce it.

Depending on territory and customer assignments, selected candidates may be required to complete employment and fingerprint-based background screening, CJIS security-awareness training, and confidentiality/security agreements, and to maintain eligibility to access government and law-enforcement facilities and Criminal Justice Information.

Cieszymy się na możliwość współpracy z osobami, które do tej pory nie miały możliwości spełnić się zawodowo i uwolnić swojego pełnego potencjału.

Naszym priorytetem jest dostarczanie pragmatycznych, ponadprzeciętnych rozwiązań outsourcingowych "szytych na miarę" dla naszych klientów
Posiadamy sieć własnych zasobów w różnorodnych branżach - Dysponujemy popartym bogatym doświadczeniem know-how, które uzupełniamy indywidualnym podejściem do każdego zagadnienia.
Dla naszych klientów realizujemy wyjątkowe projekty - małe, duże oraz bardzo złożone. Dostarczamy zarówno proste strony internetowe, jak i złożone systemy CRM czy wymagające kampanie reklamowe.
Pracujemy w małych, efektywnych i skutecznych zespołach. Zapewniając pole do rozwoju swoich kompetencji oraz możliwości awansu w naszych strukturach.
Wielu współpracowników Prolego to osoby, które zaczynały swoją przygodę zawodową bez większego doświadczenia specjalistycznego i zdobyli je, rozwijac projekty w naszej firmie!
Pracujemy głównie zdalnie ale mamy też biura operacyjne w Warszawie, Krakowie i Wrocławiu na okoliczności przepracowania fizycznie niektórych projektów ;)

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly , we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect who can bridge the gap between what our customers need to accomplish and how Vividly should be designed to support them.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding complex business processes, challenging the status quo, and turning customer requirements into scalable future-state solutions. You’ll work across business processes, accounting workflows, data, integrations, and Vividly configuration to ensure our customers are set up correctly from the beginning.

The Solutions Architect is a critical part of our customer onboarding experience. You’ll help preserve continuity from Sales through Implementation, ensure requirements are understood before teams begin building, and keep multiple implementation work streams aligned around one cohesive solution.

What You'll Achieve

As a Solutions Architect, you’ll become an expert in Vividly , CPG trade workflows, customer business processes, ERP ecosystems, and how our different solutions come together.

You’ll engage early in the customer journey to understand what was sold, why the customer purchased Vividly , and what outcomes they expect to achieve. Following Closed Won, you’ll lead Solution Alignment to validate requirements, future-state workflows, technical dependencies, assumptions, and implementation scope before execution begins.

You’ll design solutions across areas such as Trade Promotion Management, Deduction Management, Cash Application, accruals, forecasting, revenue data, master data, file retrieval, and ERP integrations. You won't personally configure every workflow or build every integration. Instead, you'll create the solution blueprint that enables Implementation, Integrations, Managed Services, and Customer Success to execute successfully.

Throughout onboarding, you’ll remain the owner of solution integrity, helping resolve ambiguity, evaluate changes, and ensure individual work streams don't make decisions that compromise the overall customer solution.

Beyond individual implementations, you’ll identify recurring patterns, process gaps, and opportunities to standardize how Vividly designs and delivers solutions so that onboarding becomes increasingly faster, more predictable, and scalable.

In This Role, You'll Help The Team:

• Review pre-sales discovery, commitments, requirements, and proposed solutions to ensure continuity from Sales into onboarding.

• Lead customer Solution Alignment sessions to validate business objectives, requirements, workflows, dependencies, assumptions, and success criteria.

• Understand customers' current-state processes and design scalable future-state workflows using Vividly .

• Translate customer requirements into clear solution designs that Implementation, Integrations, Managed Services, and Customer Success can execute against.

title: ML Runtime Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs - fast - on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast. As our ML Runtime Engineer , you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy - the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon. About this role:

Own model compilation: turn partner ONNX models into optimized engines per accelerator (TensorRT, Hailo, AMD/ROCm), within power & thermal budgets
Build the ground-side compile & delivery path; define how a mismatched engine is detected/rejected on-node
Build performance tooling: benchmarking, profiling, operator-coverage matrices, and budget validation</li

title: Lead Global CPQ & Deal Process Owner
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Position Summary

The Principal, Global CPQ & Deal Process Owner is the single-threaded owner of Delinea's quoting and deal approval process end-to-end, globally. Delinea has selected Salesforce Agentic Revenue Management (ARM) as its future CPQ platform, and this role owns the health, roadmap, and continuous evolution of the CPQ process - including AI-driven enhancements that remove friction - while being personally accountable for the AE/end-user experience across the quote-to-approval journey. The Principal will lead the GTM/RevOps side of the ARM implementation, working alongside Salesforce and Business Systems, while also ensuring the current Steelbrick CPQ environment continues to run smoothly during an expected ~9-month coexistence period as the business transitions to ARM. This role builds a world-class SaaS CPQ process in close partnership with Pricing Strategy, Deal Desk, Business Systems, and the Field.

 

This is a Principal-level, individually-driven mandate: the ideal candidate operates independently, sets the agenda for the Quoting/CPQ process globally, and is comfortable owning ambiguous, high-visibility outcomes with minimal oversight. Deep, hands-on expertise with Salesforce Agentic Revenue Management (ARM) is the top priority for this role, given Delinea's selection of ARM as its future CPQ platform; working knowledge of Steelbrick CPQ is a strong nice-to-have, since the team will need to operate and support Steelbrick alongside ARM for approximately nine months during the transition. The Principal is both the process's strategic owner and its most technical practitioner - equally fluent in deal approval logic, CPQ configuration, and the emerging landscape of agentic revenue management, and able to translate AE pain points directly into system and process change.

 

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Process Ownership & Roadmap

- Own the end-to-end health, performance, and roadmap of the Quoting/CPQ process globally, from quote creation through deal approval and booking.

- Define and prioritize the CPQ/deal approval roadmap based on business impact, friction reduction, and AE experience.

- Own the ongoing tooling roadmap for quoting and deal approval, including future vendor/capability evaluation within the Salesforce Agentic Revenue Management (ARM) ecosystem now that ARM has been selected as Delinea's future CPQ platform.

- Establish and track process health metrics (quote turnaround time, deal approval cycle time, error/rework rates, AE satisfaction) and report on process performance.

 

AE / End-User Experience & Friction Reduction

- Serve as the voice of the AE and broader end user, systematically identifying friction points, pain points, and time sinks across the quoting and deal approval journey.

- Conduct ongoing process discovery - interviews, journey mapping, and usage/data analysis - in partnership with the Field to surface and prioritize pain points.

- Design and implement AI-enhanced improvements (agentic automation, intelligent approval routing, guided selling) that reduce manual touchpoints and cycle time.

 

Agentic Revenue Management (ARM) Implementation Leadership

- Act as the GTM/RevOps project lead for Delinea's Salesforce Agentic Revenue Mana

description:

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

As a Solutions Engineer at Legora, you’ll act as a technical and strategic partner to our sales team, engineering team and prospective clients. You’ll help customers understand how Legora’s solutions solve their most complex technical challenges, lead technical discovery, create custom demonstrations, and support the end-to-end sales process.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a passion for working with customers to drive value. Your work will directly influence Legora’s growth and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

- Lead technical discovery discussions to understand customer pain points, use cases, and requirements.

- Collaborate with our Legal Engineers to create demos and proof-of-concepts that clearly illustrate how Legora’s solutions address customer challenges and create value.

- Facilitate technical workshops and proof-of-value sessions.

- Respond to technical questions, security concerns, RFI/RFP responses, and implementation feasibility discussions.

- Act as a trusted advisor and technical liaison throughout the sales cycle from early engagement to contract negotiation.

- Design and propose scalable technical solutions based on customer needs and Legora’s product capabilities.

- Translate complex requirements into clear architecture diagrams, implementation roadmaps, and proposal documentation.

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility, share customer feedback, and influence roadmap priorities.

- Partner with Go-to-Market teams to shape deal strategy and shape technical strategy early in the sales process.

- Support onboarding of technical sales content (demos and demo scripts, battlecards, case studies) that improve sales efficiency.

- Work closely with Technical Delivery and Customer Success to ensure smooth transition from pre-sale to implementation.

What You Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).

- 5+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or a customer-facing technical role (preferably B2B).

- Experienced with having technical delivery discussions, responding technical questions coming from clients.

- Experience delivering technical presentations and demos to both technical and business decision-makers.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

- French language proficiency is an advantage, though not a requirement for this role.

This is a full time, on-site position in London.

• Partner with revenue leadership to gather and translate business requirements into scalable solutions, and to prioritize work against capacity and impact

description:
Coder is looking for a Senior Account Executive to grow our diverse customer base. You’ll help bring Coder’s platform to some of the largest companies in the world, who are focused on executing AI-centric software development at scale. This role is about building trusted relationships, shaping deals, and making sure enterprise customers clearly see the value we deliver.

Day to day, you will manage the full sales cycle, from sourcing opportunities to closing contracts. You’ll work side by side with engineers, buyers, and internal partners to remove friction and move complex deals forward.

 

What you’ll do here

- Build and close a strong pipeline of enterprise accounts with large engineering organizations

- Generate qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting and inbound leads

- Lead compelling demos that differentiate Coder, and communicate our value with clarity and conviction

- Collaborate with Sales Engineers to deliver a thorough technical evaluation

- Partner with decision-makers and technical stakeholders throughout the sales cycle

- Travel as needed to support deals and customer relationships

 

What we’re looking for

- 5+ years in software sales with a strong prospecting background (ideally Developer, Agent, DevSecOps, or Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) technologies)

- 3+ years selling into Fortune 500 companies

- Experience engaging with software engineering leaders and technical decision-makers

- Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, platform engineering, and developer tools

- Experience with GenAI & Agentic development tools (Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, Goose, Copilot, etc)

- Comfortable with outbound motion and partnering with Sales Engineers

- Track record of exceeding quota and pipeline goals

- Strong communication skills - written, verbal, and in presentations

- Familiarity with different sales cycles (startup, midsize, enterprise)

- Creative, analytical, and highly self-motivated

- Ability to travel up to 15%

 

Bonus tacos if you have

- (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

- A technical background or meaningful experience with open source software

- Curiosity about emerging AI workflows, developer tools, and general tech trends

ABOUT CODER

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com http://coder.com.

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI USE DURING THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

title: Gestionnaire Staff, Opérations des incidents et des risques technologiques (Produit et Technologie)
description:
Bonjour ! Merci de passer 👋

Tu es activement à la recherche d’une nouvelle opportunité ? Ou tu regardes simplement le marché ? Eh bien… tu es peut-être au bon endroit !

Nous recherchons un Gestionnaire Staff, Opérations des incidents et des risques technologiques pour rejoindre notre équipe des opérations Produit et Technologie.

À ce poste, tu concevras et piloteras les mécanismes opérationnels permettant au pôle Produits et Technologie de réagir efficacement aux incidents, de réduire les risques d’entreprise et d’offrir aux dirigeants une visibilité claire sur les domaines nécessitant une attention particulière et des mesures concrètes. Tu faciliteras la harmonisation des processus et pratiques fragmentés, contribueras à l’établissement de normes communes, participeras à l’amélioration de la communication et du suivi, et veilleras à ce que les données pertinentes parviennent aux équipes d’ingénierie, aux dirigeants et aux responsables de la sécurité.

Tu travailleras à la croisée des opérations produit et technologie, de l’ingénierie et de la sécurité. Tu contribueras également à relier les différents domaines de risque de l’entreprise - notamment l’IA responsable, la sécurité des applications et des infrastructures, la gestion des identités et des accès, la protection des données, les risques liés à la chaîne d’approvisionnement numérique, l’informatique et l’IA « fantômes », la conformité en matière de sécurité et la résilience opérationnelle - afin de former une vision cohérente pour la direction, sans pour autant assumer la responsabilité fonctionnelle de chaque domaine.

Il s’agit d’un poste à fort impact, axé sur l’excellence opérationnelle plutôt que sur la gestion hiérarchique. Nous recherchons un(e) spécialiste senior et pragmatique, capable de s’épanouir au cœur de défis complexes en matière d’ingénierie et de sécurité, capable de collaborer avec les différentes équipes techniques pour établir des normes claires, rationaliser les workflows liés aux incidents et aux vulnérabilités, et aider les équipes à résoudre efficacement les risques opérationnels critiques sans ajouter de processus superflus.

Ce que tu feras :

Harmoniser et faire évoluer les mécanismes de gestion des incidents :

- Maintenir un cadre de gestion des incidents cohérent à l’échelle de P&T, en définissant clairement les rôles, les niveaux de gravité, les procédures d’escalade et les normes de communication.

- Faciliter les analyses post-incident (RCA/post-mortems) et veiller à ce que les actions à mener soient suivies jusqu’à leur achèvement afin d’apporter des améliorations systémiques au niveau de l’ingénierie.

Piloter les processus opérationnels liés aux incidents de sécurité et aux vulnérabilités :

- Optimiser les workflows de réception, de hiérarchisation, d’escalade et de correction des incidents de sécurité et des vulnérabilités, en collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de sécurité.

- Créer des vues de suivi mettant en évidence les vulnérabilités significatives, les tendances en matière de vieillissement et les exceptions nécessitant l’attention de la direction.

Construire une vue intégrée des risques technologiques :

- Synthétiser les informations issues de la sécurité des applications, de la gouvernance de l’IA, de la gestion des identités et des accès, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, de la protection des données et de la conformité pour obtenir une vue unifiée et exploitable des risques opérationnels.

- Identifier les schémas récurrents dans les données relatives aux incidents et aux vulnérabilités afin de mettre en place des corrections systémiques sans dupliquer les responsabilités des équipes.

Coordonner le reporting, la communication et la préparation des dirigeants :

- Suivre les indicateurs clés de performance essentiels et préparer des tableaux de bord et des rapports concis à l'intention du directeur technique (CTO), des responsables de la sécurité et du conseil d'administration.

About MarketStar :
In everything we do, we believe in creating growth, for our clients, our employees, and our community. For the past 35+ years, we have been generating revenue for the most innovative tech companies across the globe through our outsourced B2B demand, sales, customer success, and revenue operations solutions. We are passionate about cultivating career advancements for our people, and support them through mentorship, leadership, and career-development programs. We provide service and support to our communities through the MarketStar Foundation.

Our exceptional team is the cornerstone of MarketStar 's accomplishments. We are proud of our award-winning workplace culture and to be named a top employer in our industry. These achievements are a testament to our six core values, embraced by our 3,000+ employees worldwide. From our headquarters in Utah, USA, to our global offices in India, Ireland, Bulgaria, Mexico, the Philippines, and Australia, we all work together to drive innovation and success.
We are excited to have you apply to join our MarketStar team and can’t wait to discuss how we can help you find growth, as well as how you can make an impact by driving growth for your team. 
About the Program Manager
The Program Manager leads performance, execution, and strategy across multiple geographies and markets. This role oversees four distinct Customer Success (CS) motions, balancing their unique goals, workflows, customer segments, and performance expectations. By translating business objectives into regional and team-level strategies, priorities, and action plans, the Program Manager provides clear direction and aligns teams around client delivery outcomes.
Location: US Remote
What will you do?

• Own performance, execution, and strategy across multiple geographies and markets, aligning regional delivery with business objectives.

• Lead and balance four distinct Customer Success motions, adapting leadership and delivery approaches to each motion’s goals, workflows, customer segments, and performance expectations.

• Translate business objectives into regional and team-level strategies, clear priorities, and actionable plans.

• Guide teams in executing regional plans while maintaining alignment across markets and Customer Success motions.

• Monitor progress against each motion’s performance expectations and adjust priorities and action plans to address delivery gaps.

• Balance shared business priorities with the distinct needs of regional teams and customer segments.

What will you need to succeed?

• Experience leading client delivery or Customer Success programs across multiple regions, markets, or distributed teams.

• The ability to manage multiple Customer Success motions with different goals, workflows, customer segments, and performance expectations.

• Strong strategic planning skills, with the ability to turn business objectives into practical regional and team-level action plans.

• A results-oriented approach to monitoring performance, identifying delivery gaps, and adapting execution to meet objectives.

• Strong prioritization and organizational skills to balance competing demands across regions and Customer Success motions.

• Clear communication and collaborative leadership skills to align teams around priorities, expectations, and delivery outcomes.

• Adaptability to respond to differing market needs while maintaining a consistent focus on business and client objectives.

• Structured learning and career development programs

title: Principal Actuary, Cost of Care
description:
Job Description
The Principal Actuary delivers a broad range of actuarial or analytical work for the company, such as conducting pricing and actuarial strategy for a business segment, evaluating advanced care management models, performing competitive benchmarking analysis, and conducting economic value evaluation of cost containment initiatives. They support the company strategy by providing sound, consistent, and actionable actuarial analysis and recommendations, and can identify and react to nuanced risks and opportunities. This particular role will focus on performance evaluations for both existing initiatives within the Cost of Care portfolio and newly proposed initiatives across several different subject areas including clinical, pharmacy, network, payment integrity, value-based care, and more. What You’ll Do

• Accountable for completion of complex actuarial or analytical projects, ensuring timeliness, compliance, and quality of work

• Provide proactive and strategic thought leadership of ways to improve processes, reduce risks, and meet department and enterprise objectives to achieve profitable growth and/or improve value, quality, and access for Blue Cross NC customers

• Achieve segment financial targets and provide concise explanations of results and variances to expectations; act as a financial steward for the company

• Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership

• Manage external partnerships with vendors, auditors, regulators, and health care providers, including effective negotiation of contracts and/or rates

• Develop and maintain strong business relationships with internal partners through business expertise and exceptional support; act as a strategic advisor

• Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.

• Develop measurement models for various cost savings initiatives across the company’s many strategic areas including, but not limited to clinical care management, alternative payment arrangements with providers, medical coding and policy adherence practices, and other emerging drivers of trend.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in related field

• ASA designation (FSA preferred); exam takers may be considered based on other experience

• 5+ years of relevant actuarial experience, related experience may be considered.

Bonus Points

• SQL-based data queries and data management

• Experience with data visualization applications such as Power-BI and Tableau

• Experience creating and presenting external, client-facing materials and reports.

What You’ll Get

• The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of health care delivery with a team that’s deeply invested in the community.

• Work-life balance, flexibility, and the autonomy to do great work.

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage along with numerous health and wellness programs.

• Parental leave and support plus adoption and surrogacy assistance.

• Career development programs and tuition reimbursement for continued education.

• 401k match including an annual company contribution.

• Learn more 

Salary Range
At Blue Cross NC , we take great pride in a fair and equitable compensation package that reflects market-price and our starting salaries are typically planned near the middle of the range listed. Compensation decisions are driven by factors including experience and training, specialized skill sets, licensure and certifications and other business and organizational needs. Our base salary is part of a robust Total Rewards package that includes an Annual Incentive Bonus*, 401(k) with employer match, Paid Time Off (PTO), and competitive health benefits and wellness programs.
*Based on annual corporate goal achievement and individual performance.
